title: TUF Targets Metadata Schema
description: JSON Schema for TUF targets metadata files that list available target files and their cryptographic metadata

_type.description: The metadata type identifier. Always 'targets' for targets metadata.

spec_version.description: The version of the TUF specification this metadata conforms to. Should follow semantic versioning.

version.description: Version number of this targets metadata instance. Must be incremented for each new version.

expires.description: Expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Clients must reject metadata after this time.

targets.description: Dictionary of target files managed by this metadata.

delegations.description: Optional delegation configuration for distributing signing authority.

length.description: Length of the target file in bytes. Clients MUST verify downloaded files match this length exactly.

hashes.description: Dictionary of cryptographic hashes for integrity verification.

custom.description: Optional custom metadata for application-specific use.

name.description: Name of the delegated role. Must be unique within the delegation scope.

keyids.description: List of key identifiers authorized to sign for this delegated role.

threshold.description: Minimum number of signatures required from the authorized keys.

paths.description: Optional list of path patterns this role is responsible for.

path_hash_prefixes.description: Optional list of path hash prefixes this role is responsible for.

terminating.description: Whether this role terminates the delegation search.

scheme.description: The signature scheme used with this key.

keyval.description: The key value containing the public key material.

public.description: The public key value, typically hex or base64 encoded.

keys.description: Dictionary of keys available to delegated roles.

roles.description: List of delegated role definitions in priority order.
